highlights.text: New deep-field data tonight. We're resolving structures at redshifts that were invisible to Hubble. The universe's earliest assembly lines, in sharp focus.
Twenty years of Rosetta heritage: the Rosetta mission's cometary science still shapes how we interpret JWST detections of volatile-rich early planets.
LHCb Phase-II data taking continues. New analyses of rare B-meson decays will test the Standard Model with unprecedented precision this autumn.
Geomagnetic watch in effect. A CME detected by DSCOVR is expected to impact Earth's magnetosphere within 18 hours. Monitor for G2-G3 activity.
The SMACS 0723 cluster continues to yield surprises. New spectroscopic confirmations extend the catalog of high-redshift galaxy candidates.
New NIH-funded study demonstrates AI-assisted pathology detection achieving parity with expert radiologists across 14 cancer types.
